_economy.expirationRule: expiration_ms = floor((start_ms + refreshSeconds*1000) / 1000) * 1000; the window starts at FIRST VISIT and is not wall-clock aligned (MEASURED, 1720/1720 retail opens)
_economy.merchantGoldBandRule: uniform(base*8/9 .. base*10/9), i.e. base +/- 11.11% (MEASURED: four independent high-n (type, level) cells agree on a half-width of 11.09/11.15/11.17/11.25%; the exact +/-1/9 generator is INFERRED from that fit)
_economy.notExtractable: BuildingCatalogGenerationDataList and CatalogGenerationDataList are NOT in any of the APK's client bundles (probed: 0 objects of either class among 54,427), so the per-level stock roll and the gold base were server-only. Everything above is measured from the wire.

sources.buildingTypeNames: APK BuildingVendorConfigurationList + the item types each vendor was observed stocking
sources.merchantGold: retail catalog.wallet joined to GET /towns/current levels

_economy.walletSemantics: catalog.wallet is a STATIC budget for the window. shop.revenue is net cashflow: NEGATIVE when the merchant buys from the player, POSITIVE when the player buys. Remaining buy capacity = wallet + revenue, floored at 0 (never negative in 1720 opens; exactly 0 in 49). A merchant with no budget left still TAKES the item and pays 0 — 739/739 zero-price buybacks had exactly 0 remaining.

_generation.confidence: MEDIUM — the generation MODEL/schema is HIGH (il2cpp), the per-level params (pools/tiers/maxItems/prices) are an AUTHORED approximation.
_generation.determinism: Stock is deterministic per (shopId, window) so it is stable within a refresh window and re-rolls when the window advances. seed = fnv1a(shopId bytes ++ window_index).

generation.<buildingTypeId>.itemPool[].bundleId: a shop_bundles / captured catalog bundle id the client can render
generation.<buildingTypeId>.itemPool[].minQuantity/maxQuantity: per-open stock count range for this bundle (rolled)
generation.<buildingTypeId>.itemPool[].tier: 1..10 quality-ladder index (Fine=1 .. Mythical=10); the item only appears once the shop level's tierCap reaches this tier
generation.<buildingTypeId>.itemPool[].weight: relative pick weight within the unlocked pool (higher = more likely)

generation.<buildingTypeId>.levels.<1..9._unlockedPoolSize: computed: pool entries with tier <= tierCap (informational)
generation.<buildingTypeId>.levels.<1..9.maxItems: how many distinct bundles to roll into the catalog at this level
generation.<buildingTypeId>.levels.<1..9.priceMultiplier: informational scalar; server pricing still comes from the bundle def (only 5 bundles are priced server-side, the rest are priced by the client from its own asset data)
generation.<buildingTypeId>.levels.<1..9.refreshSeconds: restock window; the client refetches once it elapses
generation.<buildingTypeId>.levels.<1..9.tierCap: the max item tier (Fine..Mythical index) this level unlocks

_generation.enchanterGate: The Enchanter enchant-type gates (no Frost/Poison/Stamina/Magicka at L1) are modelled via tier: the gated (higher-grade) enchant bundles carry tier>=4, so a low-level Enchanter (tierCap 2) cannot roll them. Raising the shop level raises tierCap and unlocks them, matching retail's level-gated enchant families.
_generation.howItWorks: For an opened shop the server resolves the building's typeId + current level from the character's town, looks up generation[typeId], filters itemPool to entries with tier <= levels[level].tierCap, then deterministically rolls maxItems weighted picks (seed = shopId + refresh-window index, so stock is stable within a window and re-rolls each window). Missing typeId/level -> falls back to the capture-derived templates (never empty).
_generation.purpose: ADMIN-EDITABLE authored approximation of the retail per-level shop stock. The real server rolled a Catalog from CatalogGenerationData per (buildingType, level); those tables are server-only and were NOT captured, so this block AUTHORS a faithful stand-in. The server GENERATES a shop's catalog from this config at open time.
_generation.reloadHook: generation is pure data; a future admin route can hot-reload this file and rebuild ServerGlobal.shop_stock without a restart (see shop_gen.rs).
_generation.shopTypeAttribution: The 4 pools were attributed to Forge/Alchemist/Enchanter/Workshop by clustering the capture-derived catalog templates on shared bundle ids (captures do NOT label shop type). Forge=weapons/armor/smithing mats, Alchemist=ingredients/potions, Enchanter=soul gems/enchant mats, Workshop=building/decoration mats. AUTHOR APPROXIMATION — safe for an admin to re-attribute a bundle by moving it between pools.

confidence.captureDerivedTemplates: MEDIUM (real observed catalogs, but not level-keyed)
confidence.model/schema: HIGH (il2cpp field layout, all fields resolved)

_meta.description: Town-vendor SHOP-STOCK model for the crafting buildings (Forge/AlchemistShop/EnchantersShop/WorkShop, each maxLevel 9), keyed by building typeId. Stock is (b) RUNTIME-GENERATED SERVER-SIDE from a weighted item-bundle pool, NOT a static per-(shopType,level) table.

model.chain: BuildingCatalogGenerationData(buildingType -> catalogGenerationDataId PER LEVEL) -> CatalogGenerationData(_maxItems roll count + weighted _itemBundleData[] {weight,minQuantity,maxQuantity,itemBundleGenerationDataId} + _initialResources[]) -> ItemBundleGenerationData(items[],prices[],chests[],addOns[],townXP) -> per-open Catalog{instanceId, catalogGenerationDataId, itemBundles[], expirationTimer(refreshTimeInSeconds), wallet}.
model.levelScaling: BuildingCatalogGenerationData.GetCatalogGenerationDataIdForLevel(int level) -> a DIFFERENT CatalogGenerationData id per building level (1..maxLevel); higher levels reference richer pools. The per-level ids/pools are NOT in the client and were not captured.
model.restock: BuildingCatalogGenerationDataList._refreshTimeInSeconds (server-authoritative); the client refetches once Catalog.ExpirationTimer elapses. Fork uses a 6h window.

sources.captureApproximation: reference / fork deploy/static/shops.json: 30 capture-derived catalog templates (fixed bundle lists observed on the wire) mapped by shop-instance-id. No level dimension. Best available stand-in.
sources.itemBundlePool: APK bundle common -> ItemBundleGenerationDataList (1318 bundle defs); FULLY dumped in reference/game-defs/shop_bundles.json (the draw pool)
sources.levelStock params (catalogGenerationData: SERVER-AUTHORITATIVE — BuildingCatalogGenerationData / CatalogGenerationData / SpecialOfferCatalogGenerationDataList are NOT in ANY of the 117 client bundles, and no /shops open/refresh catalog was captured. Not extractable.
sources.vendor<->building/craftingStations/empty: APK bundle common(_client) -> BuildingVendorConfigurationList (authoritative); vendorIdentifier == building typeId
